AddConsumer.description_en: Calls AddConsumer to apply for activation of the PCDN service

AddPcdnControlRule.description_en: Adds a start/stop setting by calling AddPcdnControlRule

DeleteDomain.description_en: Calls DeleteDomain to delete a domain name

DeletePcdnControlRule.description_en: Deletes a start/stop setting by calling DeletePcdnControlRule

DisablePcdnControlRule.description_en: Calls DisablePcdnControlRule to disable a start/stop setting

EditPcdnControlRule.description_en: Modifies the start/stop settings by calling EditPcdnControlRule

EnablePcdnControlRule.description_en: Enables a start/stop setting by calling EnablePcdnControlRule

GetAccessData.description_en: Retrieves the visitor statistics for accelerated domain names at a minimum granularity of one day
GetAccessData.description_zh: 获取加速域名最小1天粒度的访客统计数据

GetAllAppVersions.description_en: Calls GetAllAppVersions to retrieve a list of all supported regions
GetAllAppVersions.description_zh: 调用GetAllAppVersions获取所有支持的地区列表

GetAllIsp.description_en: Queries the list of all supported Internet service providers (ISPs) by calling GetAllIsp
GetAllIsp.description_zh: 调用GetAllIsp获取所有支持的运营商列表

GetAllMarkets.description_en: Calls GetAllMarkets to retrieve all marketplace lists for the current user
GetAllMarkets.description_zh: 调用GetAllMarkets获取当前用户的所有市场列表

GetAllPlatformTypes.description_en: Calls GetAllPlatformTypes to retrieve a list of all supported terminal types
GetAllPlatformTypes.description_zh: 调用GetAllPlatformTypes获取所有支持的终端类型列表

GetAllRegions.description_en: Retrieves the list of all supported regions by calling GetAllRegions
GetAllRegions.description_zh: 调用GetAllRegions获取所有支持的地区列表

GetBalanceBandwidthData.description_en: Retrieves the billing cycle, billing time, peak metering values, and business types of issued bills for a user
GetBalanceBandwidthData.description_zh: 获取用户已出账单的消费周期、消费时间、计量峰值数值、业务类型等信息

GetBalanceTrafficData.description_zh: 调用GetBalanceTrafficData获取账单带宽详情

GetBandwidthData.description_en: Queries the network bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names. Data from the last 90 days is supported
GetBandwidthData.description_zh: 调用GetBandwidthData获取加速域名的网络带宽监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据

GetClientsRatio.description_en: Retrieves the distribution ratios of all clients for the current calendar month
GetClientsRatio.description_zh: 调用GetClientsRatio获取当前自然月所有终端分布比例

GetConsumerStatus.description_en: Retrieves the status information of a consumer
GetConsumerStatus.description_zh: 调用GetConsumerStatus获取客户状态信息

GetControlRules.description_en: Retrieves the list of start and stop settings
GetControlRules.description_zh: 调用GetControlRules获取启停设置列表

GetCoverRateData.description_en: Queries the PCDN coverage data of accelerated domain names at a minimum granularity of one day. Unit: %
GetCoverRateData.description_zh: 查询加速域名的最小1天粒度的PCDN覆盖率数据，单位：%

GetCurrentMode.description_en: Calls GetCurrentMode to query the current billing method
GetCurrentMode.description_zh: 调用GetCurrentMode查询当前计费方式

GetDomainCount.description_en: Calls GetDomainCount to retrieve the total number of domain names owned by the current user
GetDomainCount.description_zh: 调用GetDomainCount获取用户域名总数目

GetDomains.description_en: Queries all domain names and their statuses under the user account. Domain statuses include Normal and Disabled
GetDomains.description_zh: 查询用户名下所有的域名与状态。域名状态包括：正常、停用

GetExpenseSummary.description_en: Retrieves an overview of consumption data
GetExpenseSummary.description_zh: 调用GetExpenseSummary获取消费数据概况

GetFeeHistory.description_zh: 调用GetFeeHistory获取计费数据历史记录

GetFirstFrameDelayData.description_en: Retrieves the first frame latency data for accelerated domain names. Unit: ms
GetFirstFrameDelayData.description_zh: 获取加速域名的首帧延时数据，单位：ms

GetFluencyData.description_en: Retrieves the reference fluency rate data for accelerated domain names. Unit: %
GetFluencyData.description_zh: 获取加速域名的参考流畅率数据，单位：%

GetLogsList.description_en: Retrieves a list of logs for a specified time period for viewing and downloading
GetLogsList.description_zh: 获取当前用户选定时间的日志列表，供用户查看与下载

GetTokenList.description_en: Retrieves the list of terminal tokens

GetTrafficByRegion.description_en: Queries the traffic data for each region within the current calendar month of the user by calling GetTrafficByRegion
GetTrafficByRegion.description_zh: 调用GetTrafficByRegion获取用户当前自然月内每个地区的流量数据

GetTrafficData.description_en: Retrieves the network traffic monitoring data for accelerated domain names. Unit: bytes
GetTrafficData.description_zh: 获取加速域名的网络流量监控数据，单位：byte

StartDomain.description_en: Calls StartDomain to enable a domain name

StopDomain.description_en: Stops a domain name by calling StopDomain
